## Notes on Damage and Uncertainty

* **The Left-Hand Shadow:** Starting roughly halfway down the page (around Entry 7), a deep shadow encroaches from the left edge. By Entries 10, 11, and 12, more than a third of each line is completely blacked out, cutting off the dates, the first names of the grooms, and critical sacramental phrasing.
* **Standard Formulae:** Most of these entries follow traditional Latin formulas: *"[Names] ... matrimonio junxi, coram [Witnesses]"* (I joined in marriage..., in the presence of...) or variants featuring *dispensatione Paschali* (Easter dispensation). Parish priests signing off are **James Scanlan P.P.** and **J. J. White P.P.**
* **Surnames:** Surnames in the bottom half (Entries 10-12) like *Young*, *Elliott*, *Reidy*, and *Guerin* are highly tentative due to fading and ink bleeding adjacent to the shadow.
